# DC renderer robustness & performance hardening

## Context / Problem
The DC path shells out to pandoc per field, which introduces three production hazards proven in the DC experiment: (1) a per-field subprocess tax — latency is a flat ~0.3s/field spawn cost independent of body size, and a serial reconcile pass over many fields blocked ~20 min of wall time on `fork+exec`; (2) a pathological-input hang — one corpus body drove pandoc's jira reader to spin 13.5 min at 95.8% CPU, and pypandoc invokes pandoc with no timeout, so one field can stall the whole reconcile indefinitely; (3) pandoc is GPL and ships as a binary that must be provenance-pinned like the existing `acli`. These must be designed against before the DC codec ships.

## Approach
- **Bound the subprocess cost:** convert only via the change-gated path so unchanged bodies never spawn pandoc (the rich_sha gate from the echo-suppression story), and reuse a single pinned pandoc install cached in CI the way `acli` already is; batch a body's units into as few pandoc invocations as correctness allows rather than one-per-unit. (pandoc 3.9 exposes no `--server`/daemon, confirmed, so a persistent server is out of scope.)
- **Hard timeout + fallback:** wrap every pandoc call with a per-call wall-clock timeout; on timeout or non-zero exit, fall back to emitting the original Markdown verbatim for that field (plain is trivially echo-safe) and record the fallback, so a pathological field degrades to plaintext instead of hanging the pass.
- **Compliance:** pin the pandoc binary by version+sha, document its GPL license in the project SBOM/notice, and verify the pin in CI.

## Scope
- `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/` — the DC renderer module: timeout wrapper, verbatim fallback, invocation batching.
- CI reconcile workflow config — pinned pandoc install/cache + sha verification (mirroring `acli`).
- SBOM/licensing notice file — pandoc GPL entry.
- `tests/` — timeout/fallback tests.

## Testing
- Timeout path: a synthetic input that exceeds the configured timeout falls back to verbatim Markdown for that field and the pass completes; asserted by `test_dc_pandoc_timeout_falls_back`.
- No-op path: a reconcile pass where no body changed spawns 0 pandoc processes; asserted by a spawn-count spy in `test_dc_no_change_no_spawn`.
- Failure path: a non-zero pandoc exit degrades that field to plaintext without aborting the pass.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every pandoc invocation has a wall-clock timeout and degrades to verbatim Markdown on timeout/error; verified by `test_dc_pandoc_timeout_falls_back` (the pass completes, field is plaintext).
- [ ] An unchanged body triggers no pandoc subprocess; verified by a spawn-count assertion in `test_dc_no_change_no_spawn`.
- [ ] The pandoc binary is version+sha pinned and cached in CI and its GPL license is recorded in the SBOM/notice; verified by the CI pin check and a notice-file test.
data.title: DC renderer robustness & performance hardening
